primary_pr.body:
## Summary
- ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0173 in cargo-deny and cargo-audit config
- document that proc-macro-error2 is pulled in transitively via i18n-embed-fl/age/codex-secrets
- leave the ignore temporary until codex-secrets moves off age or age drops i18n-embed-fl

## Validation
- just fmt
- cargo deny check --hide-inclusion-graph
